input: NovaTech ki AI Data Governance policy ka document reference number aur effective date kya hai?
expected_output: Document reference NT-AIGOV-2026-07 hai aur policy 1 March 2026 se effective hai (Version 3.2).
expected_chunk_reference: Document Reference: NT-AIGOV-2026-07 | Effective Date: 1 March 2026 | Version: 3.2 | Owner: Data Governance Office

input: Naya AI system deploy karne ke kitne din baad usay Data Governance Office ke sath register karna zaroori hai?
expected_output: Naya AI system deploy hone ke 10 business days ke andar Data Governance Office ke sath register karna zaroori hai.
expected_chunk_reference: Any new AI system deployed after 1 March 2026 must be registered with the Data Governance Office within 10 business days of going live.

input: Tier 3 Confidential data ko model training mein kis tarah use kiya ja sakta hai?
expected_output: Tier 3 Confidential data ko general-purpose model training ke liye kabhi use nahi kiya ja sakta; ye sirf CISO se approved strictly isolated fine-tuning environment mein use ho sakta hai.
expected_chunk_reference: Confidential data may never be used to train a general-purpose model. It may only be used in a strictly isolated fine-tuning environment approved by the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO).

input: Restricted (Tier 4) data ka accidental training mein use ho jaye to kitne time mein report karna hoga?
expected_output: Restricted data ka accidental inclusion 24 hours ke andar Severity 1 incident ke tor par report karna hoga.
expected_chunk_reference: Restricted data must never be used for AI training under any circumstances, and any accidental inclusion must be reported as a Severity 1 incident within 24 hours.

input: Tier 2 Internal data training pipeline mein kitne time tak retain hoti hai?
expected_output: Tier 2 Internal data training pipelines mein last use ki date se 18 months tak retain hoti hai, uske baad cold storage mein archive ho jati hai.
expected_chunk_reference: Tier 2 (Internal) data used in training pipelines is retained for 18 months from the date of last use, after which it is archived to cold storage.

input: Approved fine-tuning environment mein Tier 3 Confidential data ka maximum retention period kitna hai?
expected_output: Approved fine-tuning environment mein Tier 3 Confidential data ka maximum retention period 90 days hai, aur fine-tuning job complete hote hi ise delete karna zaroori hai.
expected_chunk_reference: Tier 3 (Confidential) data used in an approved fine-tuning environment is retained for a maximum of 90 days and must be deleted immediately after the fine-tuning job completes.

input: RAG system ko 50 se zyada internal users ke liye release karne se pehle retriever evaluation mein kaunse do scores minimum 0.75 hone chahiye?
expected_output: Retriever evaluation mein Contextual Precision aur Contextual Recall dono scores approved golden dataset par 0.75 ya us se zyada hone chahiye.
expected_chunk_reference: At minimum, the evaluation must report Contextual Precision and Contextual Recall scores, and both scores must meet or exceed 0.75 on the approved golden dataset before release.

input: NovaTech ke approved AI vendor list mein kaunsi companies shamil hain?
expected_output: Approved AI vendor list mein teen companies hain: hosted LLM inference ke liye Anthropic, compute infrastructure ke liye ek regional cloud provider, aur Tier 2 data labeling ke liye ek specialized annotation vendor.
expected_chunk_reference: NovaTech's approved AI vendor list includes three companies: Anthropic for hosted LLM inference, a regional cloud provider for compute infrastructure, and a specialized annotation vendor for labeling Tier 2 data.

input: Severity 1 incident hone par CISO ko kitne time mein notify karna zaroori hai aur full report kab tak file karna hai?
expected_output: Severity 1 incident mein CISO ko 4 hours ke andar notify karna hoga aur full incident report 5 business days ke andar file karni hogi.
expected_chunk_reference: Severity 1 incidents, involving Restricted data, require the CISO to be notified within 4 hours and a full incident report to be filed within 5 business days.

input: Internal RAG ya generator evaluation ke liye banaye gaye golden datasets kitne time tak retain kiye jate hain?
expected_output: Internally generate kiye gaye model training logs aur evaluation datasets, jaise RAG ya generator evaluation ke golden datasets, audit aur reproducibility ke liye 24 months tak retain kiye jate hain.
expected_chunk_reference: Model training logs and evaluation datasets generated internally, such as golden datasets used for RAG or generator evaluation, are retained for 24 months to support audit and reproducibility requirements.
